$comment: Provenance of this native fork; scripts/native-fork-diff.mjs reads it. Update it with every upstream bump or delta change. The delta adds the synchronous per-record reads (listKeysSync / getRecordSync / getGlobalSync) the domain layer's lazy hydrate needs, plus putRecords on the single-layout unit: a batch of records applied to the authoritative memory and published as ONE document rewrite, rolled back as a whole when that publish is rejected, and a Windows-only bounded retry of the replacing rename in atomic.ts while antivirus or the indexer briefly holds the target. Every document format, the atomic publish protocol, and the single-record write paths are upstream byte-for-byte.
